title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Returns Terms
content:
Return terms of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program by tier.

| Tier | Return window (calendar days from the carrier delivery date) | Restocking fee (percent of the amount paid for the returned units) | Opened supplies returnable |
|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 30 | 15 | No |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 30 | 0 | No |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 30 | 0 | No |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 30 | 0 | No |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 30 | 0 | No |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 30 | 0 | No |

- The **return window** is the window for requesting the return of unopened, sealed items.
- The **restocking fee** is withheld from the credit for an accepted return, as a whole percent of the amount the customer paid for the returned units.
- **Opened supplies returnable** states whether opened medical supplies may be returned for credit; it is "No" on every tier.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

On a hypothetical tier with a 10 percent restocking fee, an accepted return of units for which the customer paid 100.00 USD is credited at 100.00 USD less 10 percent of it, that is 90.00 USD.
